title: Duplicate vendor records with recommended merges or mapping corrections
prompt: Find duplicate vendor records and recommend merges or mapping corrections, with all affected transactions and open balances shown before changes.

setup.q: What makes two vendor records the same vendor (same tax ID, same bank details, same legal name) and which record survives?

inputs.name: Vendor list with tax IDs and contact details
Bills, payments and AP aging by vendor

steps: pull the vendor list and the open bills, payments and AP aging by vendor
run name_similarity over the vendor list; confirm pairs with masterDataRules (tax ID, bank details, legal name)
for each confirmed pair, list every affected transaction and the open balance of each record before any change
propose a vendor update (tier B) that marks the duplicate inactive and re-points its open bills to the surviving record; a merge or a delete is never proposed

done.text: Every exception row cites both vendor ids and the evidence they are the same vendor
duplicate-vendors.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every proposal names a route the desk may call and no proposal deletes or merges a record
Affected transactions and open balances are shown before any change; records are only marked inactive or re-pointed, never merged or deleted; the approver named in setup decides

tierRules.when: marking the duplicate record inactive or correcting its mapping to the surviving record
re-pointing open bills from the duplicate to the surviving vendor
